scope: Read-only security triage; no production edits or scanner suppression

worker_environment.scope: actual native guardian; explicit fixture credentials; filtered environment; timeout and lease fencing

supervisor_watchdog.scope: actual supervised temporary workers, descendant cleanup, cancellation, lease loss, watchdog timeout and fake overnight launcher

container.scope: fake daemon contract; actual Linux Docker isolation explicitly skipped

literal_argv.scope: actual watchdog plus actual guardian via supervisor; four shell-looking argv strings, no requested shell executable, no command injection

environment_limitations: Initial worker/supervisor runs failed because sandbox forbids /bin/ps; those logs preserved and not claimed as production defects. Isolated reruns with process-table access passed.
Native same-user filesystem and actual Docker isolation not established.
Mandatory-intake guardian descriptor tests inspected, not rerun in this triage.

findings.disposition: Intentional caller-selected argv executor, no shell parsing at this sink; no command-injection bypass demonstrated. Must not treat direct legacy CLI as untrusted-code sandbox.
boundaries: routing pins selected runtime and renders separate argv
optional container replaces argv with pinned Docker attach command; fixed offline constraints
required intake branches early to protected descriptor/native assembly instead of this legacy sink

findings.disposition: Intentional operator command wrapper; only lifetime/process-group control, inherits environment and makes no separate authority/sandbox claim. Actual quoted shell-looking arguments remain literal.

Installable supported historical payload, not safe to remove from scanning as inert archival data. Current PR branch filter fixes base_ref to main, reducing present exploitability, but shell-template interpolation should be repaired consistently with current installed workflow.
findings.test_gap: G40 test-gap-fixes.sh270-273 checks existence/surfaces/decisions only; no behavioral input injection regression.

recommended_next_actions: Keep full scanner scope over both current runtime and supported installable staged workflow assets. Do not blanket-ignore verify or staged paths.
Repair the two supported staged ADR interpolations using env transfer and quoted variable, plus isolated actual-step behavioral RED/GREEN and installer identity proof; no trigger/permission changes.

Explicit shell=False may clarify existing behavior but must not be claimed to resolve this rule: current primary rule inspected by root has no shell=False exemption. Do not use shlex.quote on argv or refactor only to hide taint; retain tests of true list-argv behavior and executable/intake authority.

If exact audit rule still flags intentional arbitrary-command execution, require a narrowly reviewed rule/path/source-bound audit disposition with negative tests, retaining raw SARIF and all other error gates; do not silently waive or globally lower rule severity. Until such reviewed policy is approved, keep gate failure visible.
rule_source_limit: Frozen registry rule configuration was not retained. Root inspected current primary Semgrep rule and reports broad sys.argv/os.environ-to-subprocess taint sink with literal-list exception, no shell=False exemption. This is not exact-version equivalence proof. Original SARIF rule metadata retained separately.
